<!doctype html>
<html lang="pt-BR"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Arena imaginária — revisão</title>
<style>body{margin:0;background:#211735;color:#fff1d2;font:14px system-ui}canvas{display:block;width:100vw;height:100dvh}nav{position:fixed;bottom:4px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:2}button{background:#33243e;color:#ffe5a6;border:1px solid #d4b27c;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px}#status{position:fixed;bottom:40px;left:12px;pointer-events:none}</style></head>
<body><canvas id="game"></canvas><nav><button id="auto">Percorrer exploração → arena → retorno</button></nav><output id="status">Carregando…</output>
<script type="module">
import {AssetManager} from '../src/js/assets/AssetManager.js';
import {ToyRoomPhase} from '../src/js/toy-room/ToyRoomPhase.js';
import {createAudioSystem} from '../src/js/audio.js';
import {runToyRoomQA} from './toy-room-qa-runner.js';
import {runBattleGameplay} from './battle-gameplay-runner.js';
const canvas=document.querySelector('canvas'),status=document.querySelector('#status');
const assets=new AssetManager({manifestUrl:'/assets/manifest.json'});await assets.loadManifest();
assets.manifest.images=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(assets.manifest.images).map(([key,p])=>[key,new URL(p,location.origin+'/').href]));await assets.preload();
const audio=createAudioSystem();
canvas.width=innerWidth;canvas.height=innerHeight;
const room=new ToyRoomPhase(canvas,audio,null,()=>{},{assets});
await Promise.all([room.battle.readyPromise,room.arena.readyPromise]);
if(room.battle.error||room.arena.assetError)throw Error(room.battle.error||room.arena.assetError);
let automatic=false,last=performance.now();room.introAlpha=0;room.introBannerTimer=0;
window.arenaTest={room,assets,audio,pause:()=>{automatic=true;},run(){automatic=true;const exploration=runToyRoomQA(room,{draw:true});const battle=runBattleGameplay(room,{draw:true,restore:true});for(let i=0;i<400;i++)room.update();room.render();return {exploration,battle,returned:room.arena.state.completed};}};
document.querySelector('#auto').onclick=()=>{audio.initAudio();try{status.textContent=JSON.stringify(window.arenaTest.run());}catch(error){status.textContent=error.message;}};
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{canvas.width=innerWidth;canvas.height=innerHeight;room.render();});
function frame(now){if(!automatic){room.update(Math.min(3,(now-last)/1000*60));room.render();}last=now;requestAnimationFrame(frame);}requestAnimationFrame(frame);
status.textContent='D-pad: mover · A: pular · X: espada · Y: especial (em breve) · ↓: abaixar';document.body.dataset.ready='true';
</script></body></html>
